atomic_cutover: One code-only change. The eight tag-only models drop their bun.BaseModel embed and carry the table tag on base.TenantModel as documentation; they are DTOs, persistence uses module-owned row types with ModelTableExpr. StudentDocument and StudentDocumentFileCleanup inline the columns of documents.File and documents.FileCleanup with identical bun and JSON tags. RowMissing matches the translated not-found sentinels only, which every caller path already carries. MissingStudentError takes the driver's no-rows sentinel from its callers: database/repositories through the new database/repositories/users.MissingStudentError, services directly under its existing database/sql key, so the six retained consumers that match sql.ErrNoRows keep their behavior and the error text is unchanged.
